name: Kokoro Stage 2: safeguarded training with joint_epoch=8
short_description: First controlled Stage 2 run implementing the two t0009 root-cause fixes: DP-aware checkpoint loader and joint_epoch=8. Uses the t0009 safeguard library (JSONL logger, health gates, per-epoch checkpoints). Evaluates each epoch checkpoint with the t0008 harness. One variable changed from v6c.
